xna-type.name: PictureAlbum
xna-type.summary: Provides access to a picture album in the media library.
xna-type.remarks: The PictureAlbum class provides information about a picture album, including the picture album's Name , Pictures , and Parent . A PictureAlbum can contain both pictures and other picture albums. Obtain PictureAlbum objects through the PictureAlbumCollection.Item indexer.

property.name: Albums
property.summary: Gets the collection of picture albums that are contained within the picture album (that is, picture albums that are children of the picture album).
property.value: PictureAlbumCollection that contains the picture albums that are children of this picture album.
property.remarks: A PictureAlbum can contain pictures as well as other picture albums. This property returns the collection of picture albums that are contained within this picture album, if any. If this picture album has no child picture albums, an empty collection is returned.

property.name: IsDisposed
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the object is disposed.
property.value: true if the object is disposed; false otherwise.

property.name: Name
property.summary: Gets the name of the PictureAlbum.

property.name: Parent
property.value: PictureAlbum that is the parent of this picture album.

property.name: Pictures
property.summary: Gets the collection of pictures in this picture album.
property.value: PictureCollection that contains the pictures in this picture album.
property.remarks: A PictureAlbum can contain pictures as well as other picture albums. This property returns the collection of pictures in this picture album, if any. If this picture album has no pictures, an empty collection is returned.

method.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the PictureAlbum is reclaimed by garbage collection.

overload.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the PictureAlbum is reclaimed by garbage collection.
overload.remarks: This method overrides Finalize System.Object.Finalize . Application code should not call this method. The object's Finalize method is automatically invoked during garbage collection, unless a call to the GC.SuppressFinalize method has disabled finalization by the garbage collector. For more information, see Finalize Methods and Destructors , Cleaning Up Unmanaged Resources , and Overriding the Finalize Method .
